title: Play and pause the local H.264 reference video

input.provenance: Pre-existing local reference fixture; not copied into the repository. SHA-256 and ffprobe codec/dimensions/frame-rate/duration verified locally.

preconditions: Set KINOVEA_ORACLE_MP4 to the verified local video file.
Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix and matching Kinovea executable.
No Kinovea window may already be open.

actions.description: Use Kinovea's Ctrl+O dialog to open the specified fixture from a blank disposable workspace.
Capture the opened clip and visible metadata before playback control.
Start playback with the default Space shortcut.
Capture the visible playing control state.
Pause playback with the default Space shortcut.
Capture the visible paused control state.

expectedOutcomes.observation: The actual UI open path loads the specified 1280x720, 30 fps, 10 second H.264 reference clip.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Manual review of the Kinovea window title and visible dimensions/frame rate; input SHA-256 and ffprobe metadata are recorded.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Space starts and pauses playback, with the visible transport control changing state.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Manual review of screenshots captured before, during and after playback; no exact frame timing claim.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Exact playback timing or decoder parity with Windows is established.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Screenshots are insufficient for timing or pixel equivalence.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 to the Kinovea window it launched; it never calls wineserver -k.
evidenceConfidence: WINE_OBSERVED for clip selection and visible play/pause controls after manual screenshot review; no timing/pixel equivalence.
limitations: The local video is not committed; reproduce only with the matching SHA-256.
The video is an environmental fixture, not a licensed project fixture.
Playback/frame rate claims are not inferred from screenshots.
